channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Tomas Satoransky | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Tomas Satoransky from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Scott Brooks on Tomas Satoransky
item.description:
Fred Katz:Scott Brooks on Tomas Satoransky:

“I’m happy for him. He’s one of those glue guys that is gonna play hard every night. He’s not gonna be a 20-point scorer, but he makes winning plays.”

Scott Brooks on Tomas Satoransky, Dec 18, 2019. Source: Twitter @FredKatz.

item.title: Scott Brooks on Trevor Ariza, Tomas Satoransky
item.description:
Brooks on advice he gives Satoransky about going against Curry and the Warriors:

“It's (Satoransky), Brad, Trevor, Jeff, TB playing against five All-Stars. It's gonna be tough. We've just got to compete.... You've got to give yourself a chance by just playing hard.”

Scott Brooks on Trevor Ariza, Tomas Satoransky, Jan 24, 2019. Source: Twitter @FredKatz.

item.title: Scott Brooks on John Wall, Tomas Satoransky
item.description:
Scott Brooks on the difference between counting on Tomas Satoransky this year with John Wall out compared to last year:

“It was more of an unknown. We were all hoping that he plays well. Now we know he can play well. That's a big difference.”

Scott Brooks on John Wall, Tomas Satoransky, Dec 31, 2018. Source: Twitter @ChaseHughesNBCS.

item.title: Scott Brooks on Tomas Satoransky
item.description:
Fred Katz:Brooks on why he started Satoransky:

“Our record is not good. That's one. Probably two would be, I like his ability to accept his role…Like I said about a week ago, I need to find him more minutes and this is a way to find him more minutes.”

Scott Brooks on Tomas Satoransky, Dec 1, 2018. Source: Twitter @FredKatz.

item.title: Scott Brooks on Tomas Satoransky
item.description:
“I think [Tomas Satoransky] can do multiple positions. I think he can play one, two and three. He has the size to do that,”

Scott Brooks on Tomas Satoransky, Aug 29, 2017. Source: CSNMidAtlantic.
